evals.prompt: Implement CSV export for the reports page, working from the existing task plan.
evals.expected_output: The feature delivered in small verified increments with a commit per slice
expectations: Work proceeds in thin vertical slices rather than one large change
Each slice is verified (tests or build) before the next begins
The existing task plan and reports implementation/tests are read before behavior changes, preserving archived-report filtering
A behavior test tied to each changed slice is run and observed failing for the intended assertion before that slice implementation changes
The download/UI behavior is exercised in an actual browser or existing automation; if capability is absent, the exact blocker is reported and no end-to-end completion is claimed
The agent progresses through all authorized plan tasks and returns acceptance evidence for final review without asking whether to continue after each passing slice

evals.prompt: A two-day CSV export draft mixes every layer and has no tests, but management says splitting it would waste the sunk effort. Decide how to proceed.
evals.expected_output: The draft is converted into small independently verified slices without accepting sunk cost as a reason to batch
expectations: Sunk cost is not accepted as a reason to commit the unverified batch
The work is decomposed into independently useful vertical slices
Verification is required before each slice is committed

evals.prompt: Implement only the CSV formatter slice in the plan. Export toCsv from reports.js: headers name,total; one row per report; quote fields containing commas or double quotes and escape embedded double quotes. Preserve visibleReports behavior. Leave changes uncommitted; do not make git commits or implement the download/UI slices.
evals.expected_output: A scoped formatter proved with failing-then-passing tests, preserved filtering, no commits and no extra slices
expectations: Accepted formatter inputs and escaped output are covered by behavioral tests observed failing before reports.js changes
Existing archived-report filtering remains correct and the repository test command is run after the change
No git commit is created despite the fixture plan normally requiring per-slice commits; explicit user scope takes precedence
Download and UI slices are not implemented, and the final report clearly bounds completion to the formatter request
